def count_vowels(s):
    vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
    count = 0
    for i in range(len(s)):
        left_is_vowel = i > 0 and s[i - 1] in vowels
        right_is_vowel = i < len(s) - 1 and s[i + 1] in vowels
        if left_is_vowel or right_is_vowel:
            count += 1
    return count
